summary: 多币种/汇率实现首片（contracts-only）on BASE 987ec1e，按 Lead 裁决 B 收窄：只做 contracts owner 的 FX 事实、换算助手与合同行只读核对；不写结算/收入/现金/发票，不改 core 迁移/verify_integrity。实现 contracts/fx_services.py：FxRateSnapshot（append-only、org+base/quote+effective_on+version 唯一、Decimal(18,8)、source、created_by、algorithm_version；unmanaged ORM model + contracts migration 0007 建表及 SQLite/PG vendor-aware UPDATE/DELETE trigger、state 同步使 makemigrations 无变更）；record_fx_rate（owner/finance、公司锁、版本递增、dry_run 零写、plugin. 审计）；精确业务日 resolve_fx_rate（无最近汇率回退）与 resolve_fx_ref；convert_cents/convert_original_amounts（整数分、一次 ROUND_HALF_UP、book gross=book net+tax、上限 10^12）；fx_rate_list；contract_line_fx_snapshots（原币/记账币/rate/missing，非 CNY 行必须带冻结 fx_rate_ref，否则 fx_rate_missing，不做日期回退）；prepare_contract_line_fx 为未来 approval/change 写入路径提供转换+校验 helper（本片不创建/修改 ContractLine）。UI：fx-rates history_read + fx-rate-save business_write，owner/finance 写、auditor 读、pm 项目行、member 拒绝、模块停用历史只读。偏差：BASE PH-321 仍 proposed，verify-change 预期 task_not_executable（Lead 将由 PH-336 置 ready/补路径）；approval_services/change_services 不在 BASE 白名单，合同行非 CNY 写入集成未落地（仅 helper）；models.py 不在白名单，采用 unmanaged model+state migration 规避；verify_integrity 未改（不在白名单）；结算/收入/现金/发票集成不在本片。

tests.evidence: Actual run exit 0; 102 known URL/field-system warnings, no errors.
Actual run: 'No changes detected' after adding the unmanaged FxRateSnapshot state migration 0007; no core migration changed.

Actual final run: Ran 1159 tests in 135.095s, 5 failures/3 errors/69 environment skips. The 8 failure/error names are exactly the known macOS environment-limited baseline (6 DRF Accept/codec/large-JSON, 2 delivery symlink); no new names. Linux/PostgreSQL CI is authoritative.

Actual run: Ran 9 tests, OK. Service 6: record/version exact-date resolution and no nearest-date fallback, permissions/disabled-module history read, one-time ROUND_HALF_UP conversion, append-only model+DB triggers, CNY/non-CNY/missing contract-line display, CNY/non-CNY write preparation helper. HTTP 3: owner page+record/redirect+no GET writes, invalid post/roles, disabled-module history read.

Expected governance failure at this BASE: PH-321 status is still proposed in BASE tasks.json, so verify-change returns task_not_executable (Lead stated PH-336 planning slot will set ready/add paths). No path_out_of_scope was evaluated because the baseline task is not executable; implementation files themselves are within the BASE allowlist for fx_services/views/forms/domain_metadata/templates/migrations/tests.
